lines.zh: 我脚掌落地很轻，几乎无声
lines.en: My feet land almost silently.

lines.zh: 尾巴在后面摆着，保持平衡
lines.en: My tail swings behind for balance.

lines.zh: 我一侧身就滑进了草丛
lines.en: One twist and I slip into the grass.
Some of my scales are dark.
I hold the spear across my body.

lines.zh: 我弓着背走路，像随时会跳
lines.en: Hunched, as if ready to spring.
I cross wet clay without sinking.
I move between rock gaps.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边伸出舌头
lines.en: I flick my tongue as I walk.

lines.zh: 脚步很轻，我能走在你身后
lines.en: My steps are light; I can walk behind you.
I skirt a pool of water.
I crouch, tail curled.

lines.zh: 我把矛尖在石头上磨了磨
lines.en: I hone the spear tip on a stone.
I am listening nearby.
My tongue flicks in and out.
I check the spear haft.
This place has many cracks.
I dislike fighting face to face.
Flattened against the stone, I cool off.

lines.zh: 风吹草动我都看在眼里
lines.en: Every stir of the grass is noted.

lines.zh: 我侧过头看你，只有一只眼
lines.en: I turn one eye on you.
You stand too upright, too obvious.
Your armor has a gap at the side.
I flick my tongue and taste the air.
Your heel is off the ground.
I am in no hurry; I am finding an angle.
Which side are you standing on?

lines.zh: 我看你的膝盖比看脸多
lines.en: I look more at your knees than your face.
While you speak, I do not move.
I hiss and turn my flank.
Several scales are split.
That cost me half a foot.
I can still jump.
I tighten my grip on the spear.
My breathing has quickened.
I will remember this spot.
Then try that once more.
That could be eaten.
You hold it too high.
I am not picky; raw will do.
Put it on the stone.

lines.zh: 我绕到你伸手够不到的地方
lines.en: I move where your reach cannot follow.
I will sniff it three times.
This one I can chew.
Do not push your hand forward.
I still have to move on.
I will carry off the rest.
I yield and slide away.
What you hit was scale, not skin.
I retreat to better ground.
My spear swung across.
Our collision throws dust up.
My tail sweeps your legs.
I lost a little on that one.
I am out of that spot at once.
I dislike being held close.
I keep to myself.
My nest is in a rock crack.
My spear is my companion.
I hunt in this stretch of water.
When our kind meet, we fight.
I need no one following me.
Just keep your voice down.
I am going now.
We will talk next time.
I scoop it up with one hand.
This can be sharpened.
I bite it; not flesh.
I tuck it into the cloth at my waist.
It rolled into the water.
It's mine; no one at the water saw.
I toe it out of the way.
This weight does not hinder me.
I am taking it.
The grass at your flank hides me well.

lines.zh: 你转身那下，我已经贴地。
lines.en: By the time you turn, I'm already low and close.
I am already behind you.
The spear tip arrives first.
Standing there makes you a target.
Do not retreat into the water.

lines.zh: 我从岩壁上一路滑下来。
lines.en: I slide down the rock face toward you.
I will not miss this time.
My tongue tingles with excitement.

lines.zh: 你已经在我这个角度里了
lines.en: You are already in my angle.
I have the throat fixed.
Only a few steps remain.

lines.zh: 蜥蜴的舌头，先替你试了空气。
lines.en: My lizard tongue tastes the air for you.
I move on stone without a sound.
The grass does not hide you from me.
I can circle all day.

lines.zh: 你每退一步都靠近石壁
lines.en: Each step back brings you nearer the cliff.
Your boots are soaked.

lines.zh: 你听不见我，但我很近了
lines.en: You cannot hear me, but I am close.
I know this ground well.
You still have one way out.
And I hold that very path.
Come a little closer.
Best if you do not move now.
The spear tip thrusts in.
That went for your knee.
My claws rake your wrist.
This blow strikes your shield side.
There is venom in my teeth.
That did not go through.
I withdraw and change angle.
My tail sweeps your ankle.
That opened a cut.
I slip in close again.
My spear has a long reach.
You turned the first aside.
Then one comes from low.
That one used all of me.
You are still standing. Good.
A shadow at the water's edge.
First I scanned the cliffs.
Water still hangs on my scales.
The cliffs here are high.
I raise my spear upright.
A fresh mark on the grass.
I flick my tongue and taste the wind.
Something sounds in the cave.
My tail sweeps the water.
The water here runs slowly.
Fire blisters my scales.
I slide down the rock face.
Water closes over my head and I panic.
The blast throws me against stone.
Something pierces my shoulder.
That force numbs my scales.
Lightning strikes me and I freeze.
No water here, and no stone.
